title: Mark u64::MAX as a valid final DAO Origin Sequence vector
description: P2 protocol/vector correctness: generate_packets_timing.py defines is_valid_dao_sequence() with sequence < 0xffffffffffffffff and emits seq_max_invalid=True, while spec/05-routing.md says the counter starts above zero and at u64::MAX must not originate another DAO or wrap, and dao_origin_signature.json explicitly contains valid_max_u64_sequence. DaoManager likewise permits max as the final newly allocated sequence and only rejects a subsequent allocation. Align packets-timing generation/field naming and consumers so u64::MAX is valid when greater than the prior floor but terminal for further origination.
